top_choice_rationale: B013 to Kane, Mele and Molenkamp is a complete, falsifiable chain: a time-reversal-protected Z2 prediction, then a quantitative edge-conductance measurement in HgTe that nature could have contradicted, followed by about eighteen years of independent confirmation. No member disputes the physics or maturity. Allocation imperfections (the Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang proposal, Hasan) are real but are handled by a citation limited to the quantum spin Hall state and its first observation, so a prize is clearly preferable to no award.
